g.text: Layouts for Google Slides and PowerPoint (exports/SMART-deck-template.pptx), drawn as 1920 × 1080 frames. Select a slide group and choose Frame selection to make it a Figma frame.
The frames every slide is built on. Text in placeholders is a prompt.
Title · The first slide. One per deck.
Who it is for · month year
Section · Opens each part of the deck. Number the sections.
One line on what this section covers
Title and body · Plain points. Five bullets at most, one line each where possible.
Text and picture · A point with an illustration or a screenshot beside it.
Title only · For cards, steps, tables and charts composed on the slide.
Big number · One number that matters, with what it means.
One or two sentences of context
Quote · A quotation, always with who said it.
Closing · The last slide: the ask, or how to get in touch.
The layouts filled in, with cards and steps composed on Title only.
